notes.title: Trevor Henderson’s new cursed images: creatures in LURKS WITHIN WALLS
notes.notes:
[b]Trevor Henderson[/b] is a renowned horror artist, best known for his viral creations like [i]Siren Head, Long Horse, and Bridge Worm[/i]—monsters that have captivated audiences and become icons of internet horror. His career has been built on a talent for crafting surreal and grotesque creatures that blend the familiar with the nightmarish. Each of Henderson’s designs seems to emerge from the darkest corners of our subconscious, evoking primal fears.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182190/4435d6b2a070254a9843a3ae5c2ed6ba3d78c648.png[/img]

Also known as [url=https://www.instagram.com/trevorhenderson/]Slimyswampghost[/url], Henderson first gained widespread attention through his online illustrations, which often featured cryptic captions and grainy, vintage-style photographs that made his creatures feel eerily plausible. His ability to tap into modern fears with classic horror techniques quickly established him as a leading figure in contemporary horror art.

His work has heavily inspired community-driven storytelling across various media. Fans are drawn to his unique ability to turn everyday objects and environments into harbingers of terror, making even the most mundane scenes unnervingly threatening.

Now, Henderson’s terrifying visions find a new home in LURKS WITHIN WALLS. His signature creations, with their distorted proportions and haunting presence, add an entirely new dimension of fear to the game. As players explore the dark and decaying environments, they’ll encounter Henderson’s twisted monsters—each one a test of survival and wits. With his expertise, LURKS WITHIN WALLS promises to deliver the kind of spine-chilling horror that has become Henderson’s trademark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182190/2a44a7143d8e83422a5f5f5f3ad15dc2b48338e3.png[/img]
Recently, we asked Trevor Henderson’s fans which creature they’d love to see brought to life in our game. After an overwhelming response, the winner was clear: the [b]Three-armed Aberration[/b]! This grotesque creature will be lurking within the game, blending Trevor’s unsettling design with our eerie environments. Brace yourself and get ready to face its deadly presence!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182190/a5b292a66750dbe8407451bf1aba89ca320c5263.jpg[/img]
We are not stopping here, as there’s many more monsters to come. Now we ask you: [b]which creature you would like to see in LURKS WITHIN WALLS?[/b] Let us know your favorite in the comments.

And if you are a Trevor’s art style fan, consider following and adding LURKS WITHIN WALLS to your wishlist. For more of his art, join our Discord Server and follow us on [url=https://linktr.ee/2wedges]Social Media[/url].

[url=https://discord.gg/NnGYzTcGDX][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182190/5e080f9cb253a3c7b29fe9ce7f15dc7194741080.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: LURKS WITHIN WALLS: Survive this unique combination
notes.notes:
Dive into a unique blend of survival horror and modern dungeon crawling in [b]LURKS WITHIN WALLS[/b], combining tactical turn-based combat, resource scarcity, and terrifying encounters with disturbing creatures illustrated by renowned horror artist [b]Trevor Henderson[/b], creator of [i]Siren Head and Long Horse[/i].

[previewyoutube=VZTGC7kFWcc;full][/previewyoutube]
Survival hinges on carefully managing limited resources and making life-or-death decisions, evoking the dread of famous titles like [i]Resident Evil[/i]. Combat is strategic, forcing you to weigh each action, knowing you might not survive the next encounter. Choose wisely between surviving residents, armed with pipes and makeshift weapons, or police officers, striving to eliminate threats. However, keep in mind that combat may not be the easiest way to surpass a challenge. 

Exploring the decayed, atmospheric, and cursed environments heightens the tension, as the next corner could hide new unknown threats. As you navigate these twisted spaces, you’ll also face moral choices: rescue your loved ones or focus on your survival. Each decision shapes the outcome of the story.
Inspired by horror classics and infused with modern RPG elements, [b]LURKS WITHIN WALLS[/b] delivers an oppressive, immersive experience that keeps players on edge from start to finish. 

Are you ready for what [b]LURKS WITHIN WALLS[/b]? Join our Discord server and help shape the future of this relentless nightmare.
